text: The first real architecture decision: one Ledger, one Legal Entity, and a five-segment Chart of Accounts for Stonefield Distribution.
Stonefield Primary Ledger and Legal Entity Stonefield Distribution Inc. -- one company, one calendar, one currency.
Company, Cost Center, Account, Intercompany, and Future -- five segments, each earning its place for a real reason.
Cost Center gets its own segment, separate from Account, specifically so department-level reporting is actually possible.
Next: planning how the five subledgers actually post against this structure.
